content: अपावृत्त {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 (With <ab>abl.</ab>) Turned away from, averted, reversed, repelled, driven back, defeated; कथं द्रक्ष्याम्यपावृत्तां परैरिव हतां चमूम् <ls>Rām. 2. 12. 64</ls>. .²2 (Actively used) Dismissing, scorning, rejecting with contempt; प्रतिग्रहादपावृत्तः सन्तुष्टो येन केन चित् <ls>Mb.</ls> .{@-त्तम्@} .²1 Rolling on the ground (of a horse). .²2 Moving aside (a war manoeuvre); परावृत्तमपावृत्तमपद्रुतमवप्लवम् <ls>Rām. 6. 40. 25</ls>.
